provenance:
M41, the second half of postmortem shape S2. The per-item extracted text was a bare `<pre class="text">` — role `generic`, dropped by `observe.SKIP_ROLES` — so the largest output region on the page was unreachable by the role tier. sec-10k-extract's legibility row gives it `role="region" aria-label="Item <n> extracted text"` in BOTH view modes (that repo's own Markdown-view decision, and its D10). This case measures that a plan naming that region resolves and extracts the item text. Fixture `src/browser/fixtures/sec10k-inspector.html` is the rendered snapshot described in `sec10k-doc-status-is-a-named-status`, captured with item index 6 ("4 — Mine Safety Disclosures") selected because it is the smallest extracted item on aapl-2025 at 93 characters — a fixture carrying Item 1A's 68,162 would be a 68KB file grading nothing extra. Ground truth from `/api/extract/fixture` (rule 6 per-site ground-truth endpoint, eval side only), re-verified 2026-08-26 against `git_sha` `5a44758598f5`: item `4`, status `extracted`, `chars` 93. Watched RED first two ways: (1) `expect.answer` a placeholder — `answer_matches: false`, reason `answer 'Item 4. Mine Safety Disclosures

Not applicable.

Apple Inc. | 2025 Form 10-K | 18

PART II' != expected 'PLACEHOLDER'`; (2) with `role="region" aria-label="Item 4 extracted text"` stripped from the fixture's `<pre class="text">` — the pre-legibility shape, recorded verbatim in this file's `triage.red_first`.

triage.red_first: with `role="region" aria-label="Item 4 extracted text"` removed from the fixture's `<pre class="text">`, the run is `failure:locate`: `step 3 (extract): relocation after locate failure: retargeting as {'text': 'Item 4 extracted text'}; ResolveError: no tier resolved {'text': 'Item 4 extracted text'}`. The relocation rung retargets on the accessible name it was denied, and a name that only ever existed as an `aria-label` is not page text, so nothing resolves — exactly the shape the postmortem predicted for the demo.
triage.note: This case says the region RESOLVES, not that a planner could have named it: the page-level observation stops before it, which is what `sec10k-item-text-region-is-past-the-observation-cap` pins. The pair is the finding, the same way `live-quotes-js-role-tier-blind` and `live-quotes-js-text-tier-reaches` are a pair.
